name: paddock-api
description: Self-hosted F1 data API for Glance dashboards: session times in your own timezone, live standings, track maps and tyre-stint data, cached around the race calendar instead of a fixed TTL.

ports.name: Port
ports.description: API port for your Glance custom-api widgets.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: IANA timezone every timestamp is converted to.

variables.name: Track colour
variables.description: Hex colour for the track-map line.

variables.name: Event detail
variables.description: main (quali + races), race, or detailed (includes practice).
